# Earth API

> Earth API is an independent, maintainer-operated AI API relay for developers using OpenAI- and Anthropic-style interfaces. The public product link is https://api.earth.icu and the documented base URL is https://api.earth.icu/v1.

Live launch verified on 30 September 2026 at 22:27 (Asia/Shanghai): the English product page, official developer documentation, OGS-backed console and sign-up entry, public pricing rows, and authenticated model catalog are live. Thirteen end-to-end checks passed for `gpt-6-sol` and `claude-opus-5-5`, covering JSON and SSE responses, OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses, native Anthropic Messages, tool calls, errors, and final usage. Model access, upstream capacity, and pricing can change; query the catalog and review live rates before use. Earth API is independent and does not imply an official relationship with an upstream model provider.

Use an Earth API key only from server-side code. Keep keys, account tokens, billing details, private prompts, personal data, and production secrets out of public issues and repositories. Query the authenticated model catalog before selecting a model, and review current account pricing before generation.

## Official developer surface

- [Product page](https://api.earth.icu): English landing page with additional language options.
- [Official documentation](https://api.earth.icu/docs): Quickstart, OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages, streaming, usage, key management, and errors.
- [Models & pricing](https://api.earth.icu/models): The public page currently lists `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-6-luna`, and `gpt-6.1-sol`, with USD rates per million tokens. The earlier Claude launch-validation result is historical and does not imply current catalog availability; the catalog and rates can change.
- [Console](https://api.earth.icu/console): OGS-backed workspace and public sign-up entry.

## Repository documentation

- [One-page developer overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-overview.md): Concise launch status, preview scope, resources, safety checks, and operator disclosure.
- [OpenCode quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-opencode.md): Custom-provider configuration, secure key handling, model selection, compatibility notes, and troubleshooting.
- [aider quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-aider.md): OpenAI-compatible endpoint configuration, secure key handling, current-model selection, compatibility notes, and troubleshooting.
- [Continue quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-continue.md): OpenAI-compatible provider configuration for VS Code and JetBrains, model selection, secret handling, capability cautions, and troubleshooting.
- [Cline quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-cline.md): OpenAI-compatible provider setup, secure key handling, current-model selection, agent approval cautions, and troubleshooting.
- [Production-readiness checklist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-production-readiness.md): Go/no-go gates for account access, models, pricing, authentication, secrets, spending controls, compatibility, support evidence, and rollback.
- [Compatibility snapshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-compatibility.md): Endpoint-by-endpoint launch validation, streaming and tool-call coverage, authentication mapping, and known parameter boundaries.
- [Machine-readable service metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-service.json): Repository-hosted launch status, canonical URLs, interface paths, resources, safety checks, limitations, and disclosures.
- [Integration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api.md): Live-service setup, direct connectivity checks, compatibility notes, security guidance, and troubleshooting.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-openapi.yaml): Machine-readable request shapes for model discovery, Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages.
- [Postman collection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/earth-api-postman-collection.json): Importable requests with generation disabled until the user explicitly opts in.

## Examples

- [Dependency-free Node.js example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/examples/earth-api-node.mjs): Lists models by default and sends no generation request without explicit environment settings.
- [OpenAI JavaScript SDK example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/examples/earth-api-openai-sdk.mjs): Node.js 22+ example for Chat Completions or Responses, including opt-in streaming text, terminal-state checks, explicit generation flags, and automatic retries disabled.
- [OpenAI Python SDK example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/examples/earth_api_openai_sdk.py): Python 3.10+ example for Chat Completions or Responses with explicit generation flags and automatic retries disabled.
- [Anthropic Messages Python example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/examples/earth_api_anthropic_messages.py): Dependency-free Python 3.10+ client that lists models by default and requires explicit generation flags for one Messages request.
- [Anthropic Messages Node.js example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/examples/earth-api-anthropic-messages.mjs): Dependency-free Node.js 22+ client that lists models by default and requires explicit generation flags for one Messages request.
- [Go standard-library example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/examples/earth-api-go.go): Dependency-free Go client that lists models by default and requires explicit flags for one Chat Completions or Responses request.
- [PHP 8.2 example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HansO-o/Octo-Travel/main/docs/examples/earth-api-php.php): Dependency-free CLI client that lists the authenticated model catalog by default and requires explicit flags for one Chat Completions or Responses request.
